title: How a day at Mustang Trails runs.
intro: Gates open at 8 am and the last riders roll out by 7 pm. Come for a couple of hours or stay all day. Here's how a typical day goes.

rows.title: Gates open.
rows.text: Park, unload and head to check-in.

rows.title: Safety briefing.
rows.text: Trail map, rules and today's conditions.

rows.title: Ride.
rows.text: Easy, intermediate and advanced loops open.

rows.title: Break at the shelter.
rows.text: Bring lunch and plenty of water.
